meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 安装后,你选中的 NanoClaw 智能体容器内会装上 `dial` 命令和技能并注入密钥,可发短信、拨打 AI 语音电话、接收验证码;未选中的会被网关拦截并收到 403。重跑可改授权名单。
howto.when: 当你想让智能体在聊天里发短信、打电话或执行 `dial …` 命令,又不想把 Dial 配置为消息通道时;需在 NanoClaw 仓库主机上运行 `/add-dial-tool`。

say.text: 给 13800138000 发条短信,说“明天下午三点见”。
say.note: 智能体调用 dial 发出这条短信。

say.text: 打 010-12345678,问问对方收到合同没有。
say.note: 智能体用 dial 发起 AI 语音电话。

say.text: 帮我看看 13800138000 有没有收到验证码。
say.note: 智能体通过 dial 接收验证码。

howto.what_en: The chosen NanoClaw agents get the `dial` CLI, its skill, and a scoped key in their container, so they can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes; others are blocked at the gateway with 403. Re-run to change the selection.
howto.when_en: When you want an agent to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat without wiring Dial as a messaging channel; run `/add-dial-tool` on the host in the NanoClaw repo.

say_en.text: Send a text to 13800138000: see you tomorrow at 3pm.
say_en.note: The agent uses the dial CLI to send it.

say_en.text: Call 010-12345678 and ask if they got the contract.
say_en.note: The agent places an AI voice call with dial.
The agent receives codes through dial.
